Use case: illustration-story. Asset: FOUR SCENES of a Korean female-chibi historical COMIC BOOK for Goguryeo prologue. Use supplied reference 1 for EXACT character identity (four columns, row-major); reference 2 for fully illustrated comic art style and staging ONLY. DO NOT recreate Silla people or yellow uniforms from style reference. Characters all adult WOMEN with three-head-tall chibi proportions. Yeon Gaesomun: short black bob, gold bird ornament, stern crimson eyes, black-red-gold armor, arms often crossed. Jeongto: her younger SISTER, high black ponytail with red headband, warm crimson eyes, fur-trimmed armor. Go Jeongui: silver-white long hair, black tall scholar hat with gold trim, calm amber eyes, scroll and black-red scholar robes. Go Yeonsu: high black bun with red headband, red eyes, athletic commander with spear, friendly bravado. Go Hyejin: loose wavy brown hair, red eyes, thoughtful practical black-red armor. Yeongnyu is female crowned Goguryeo ruler in formal black-red robes.
Warm brown ink outlines, rich hand-painted 2D anime cel shading, expressive comic facial acting and body language, detailed Korean architecture and clothing, red Goguryeo military flags and black-red-gold armor. No 3D, photorealism, pixels or Japanese motifs.
EXACT 2x2 grid with FOUR equal landscape cells, vertical and horizontal cuts precisely at 50%. Overall landscape 3:2. No outer border or gutters (viewer will supply page borders). Each cell is a FULL DRAWN NARRATIVE ILLUSTRATION, never portraits floating on a shared palace background or a lineup of character cards. Draw actual physical interactions, distinct environments and props specified. Keep all character FACES mainly in the lower 60 percent of each cell; upper 30 percent of each cell is detailed uncluttered sky/wall/tent background available for HTML dialogue. No text, letters, speech balloons, numbers, labels, UI or watermark. Do not add unlisted named characters or duplicate figures. FIVE when specified means exactly five total.
TOP LEFT scene 1: Goguryeo northern stone-wall construction camp at dawn: stern short-black-bob Yeon Gaesomun observes empty rice bowls while her red-headband ponytail younger SISTER Yeon Jeongto explains the missing supply carts.
TOP RIGHT scene 2: Gaesomun crosses her arms sternly at a locked granary; younger sister Jeongto gently holds out a hand; Gaesomun realizes the small brass key is on her own belt and looks embarrassed.
BOTTOM LEFT scene 3: Exactly FIVE Goguryeo women generals gather at a wooden dispatch table by the unfinished wall: Gaesomun, Jeongto, white-haired Go Jeongui with scroll, red-headband high-bun Go Yeonsu with spear and wavy-brown-haired Go Hyejin with checklist.
BOTTOM RIGHT scene 4: Go Jeongui calmly questions Jeongto while drawing cart-wheel tracks on blank parchment, both carefully listening to a construction worker off frame.
